entries.description: Send one photo of whole coffee beans, green or roasted; get the country the coffee was most likely grown in, scored against about 10 countries, or a refusal when the photo does not look like beans the model knows. Free, no key; one photo at a time.

is this Ethiopian or Colombian coffee
